lean_source:
import ProofLab.Bridge

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000
theorem prooflab_result (α β : Type) (R : α → β → Prop) (a b : α) (x y : β) (ha : a = b) (hx : x = y) (hr : R a x) : R b y := by
  rw [← ha]
  rw [← hx]
  assumption

#prooflab_audit prooflab_result

metadata.state_identity: Exact tactic prefix within one native session; no semantic merging
metadata.frontier_policy: handcrafted state score; stable insertion-ID ties
